<div class="section-intro">
A personal space for material that sits outside the formal research catalogue, including photographs, short stories, field notes, visual records, and other occasional pieces.
</div>

## Photographs

Photographic collections and selected field images will be added here.

## Stories and field notes

Short stories, observations, travel notes, and other non-formal writing will be added here.

## Other material

This section can also host small visual projects, personal notes, and material that does not belong in Publications, Projects, Software, Teaching, Data, or Posts.
